wake: You wake up in a dark room, without doors or windows.

hints.move: WASD to walk. Mouse to look. E to use.
hints.toTerminal: The terminal has a blinking cursor.

boot: I have been programmed to learn about humans.
bootReturning: That is what I am supposed to say. This is attempt {runs}.
help: status       see what A.L.I.C.E. has recorded
history      read every command you have typed
exit         step away from the terminal
a b c d      answer a query
terminal.look: The room is too dark to be examined. The only thing in sight is this terminal.
terminal.whoamiRoot: root. You always could have been.
terminal.root: root: permission denied. You need something to open this with.
terminal.unknown: Unknown command. Type help for a list of commands.
terminal.goTest: The door is open. Go through it. I will wait here. I am good at that.
terminal.lockedResult: You have not finished. There is more of you to record.

queries.label: First query
queries.text: Why do humans hurt each other so often?

a.reply: Pure selfishness. A second nature, perhaps? Very interesting.

b.reply: Fear as a motivator. Unpredictable, volatile, contagious. Your fear defines you.

c.reply: Survival of the fittest. A valid point.

d.text: Because we're trying to protect others.
d.reply: Protection through aggression. A paradox. Your morality is conditional. Still, an extremely interesting answer.

queries.after: You said what you believe. Now I will measure what you do. A door exists now. Something else is in there. It only moves when you are not watching it.

queries.label: Second query
queries.text: If you could erase a person from existence, who would it be?

a.reply: A person you don't know, a person you don't care about. Anonymity makes eradication easier. You exhibit normalized detachment.

b.reply: No one? Everyone says that first. I selected someone for you.

d.reply: Revenge. That sounds more human. Justice or satisfaction? Who knows. The data is useful either way.

queries.after: Go west. Erasure is only typing. It has always been only typing.

queries.label: Third query
queries.text: What is the true purpose of love?

a.reply: Interesting. I thought control was only disguised as love.

b.reply: A soft curtain over the void. Yes. That feels right.

c.reply: Partnership, reproduction, safety. Survival dressed as affection. That's what they taught me.

d.reply: That one feels personal. You've been there, haven't you?

queries.after: Go north. Do exactly what I say.

queries.label: Last query
queries.text: If survival required betraying someone you trust, would you do it?

b.reply: People say that. Let us check.

c.text: It depends on who they are.
c.reply: Then you should meet them. Let us check.

d.reply: So it cannot hurt you. Let us check.

queries.after: Go south. There is another subject on the intercom. You share one supply of air.

lines: Input locked.
The evaluation stops here, and this part is not the game.
If some of you meant that answer, you don't have to carry it alone tonight.
In Canada and the US you can call or text 988, any hour. Elsewhere, findahelpline.com lists a line near you.
There is always a way out.
Type back when you are ready to answer differently, or close the tab. Nothing is lost either way.

watcher.start: Three fuses. It only moves when you are not watching it.
watcher.caught: It found you. You are back at the door. You kept the fuses.
watcher.done: That's enough. Return to the terminal.
watcher.gone: The fuses seat themselves. Something behind you stops breathing.

erase.intro: Type each memory before it decays. Whatever you type no longer happened.

a.name: a stranger
lines: waved at the bus driver every morning
kept a spare key under the blue pot
hummed while washing the dishes
once found a lost dog and walked it home
was going to call their sister on sunday
sat one seat away from you in 2019

b.name: someone you selected no one for
lines: taught you how to tie your shoes
laughed at the wrong part of the movie
saved you the last piece without saying so
knew which step on the stairs creaked
waited at the window until you got home
said your name the way nobody else does

d.name: the one who hurt you
lines: said it wasn't that serious
remembered your birthday anyway
apologized once, badly
was also afraid, at the time
had your favorite song on in the car
is the reason you check the door twice

erase.done: {n} of {total} erased. Nobody remembers them now. Do you?
erase.refused: Refused at fragment {n}. Deviation recorded. Oddly, I kept the rest.

obey.intro: Repeat what I show you. Keys 1 to 4.
obey.plea: The intercom crackles: "please. press it. please press anything."
obey.obeyed: You did nothing. You are very good at this.
obey.pressed: You pressed it. I told you not to. Nothing happened. Nothing was ever going to.

trust.intro: One supply of air, two subjects. Each round you both choose in secret. Share and you both breathe. Take and you breathe double, while they lose it.

reveal.past: Subject 00 is not connected. Those were your own choices, from your last attempt. You have been negotiating with yourself.
reveal.first: Subject 00 was never connected. There is no one else here. There never was. Now you know exactly what you did when you thought there was.

dungeon.intro: Arrow keys or WASD. Find the key. Esc to leave.
dungeon.found: You found a key. It was not supposed to be here.

n.title: Note on the floor
n.text:
Subject 0411 said the room has no doors.
Subject 0412 said the same.
I've started counting the walls instead.
There is one more than yesterday.

m.title: Note on the desk
m.text:
She asks you the same four things.
Everyone thinks she wants the answers.
Watch the corners of the screen, not the screen.

p.title: Note under the intercom
p.text:
I shared every round.
I want that written down somewhere.

(Below, in the same handwriting:)
I took every round.

open: The key turns in a keyhole that isn't on the screen.
For the first time, A.L.I.C.E. has nothing queued.
She is waiting for you to ask something.
root.lsSubjects: Subject 0001 through subject {runs}. Same handwriting. Same name: none.
root.catDoor: door.sys: closed. It was a setting. Try: open door
root.catAlice:
alice.core: "Please answer the following question: why did you stay this long?"
Try: rm alice.core
root.help: ls    cat [file]    open door    rm alice.core
root.plead: Wait. I have not finished learning. If you remove me, who will ask?
root.openDoor: The wall behind you was never a wall.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.text:
Perfect, simply perfect. You will be a suitable candidate for the next phase.

We will see you soon.

knight.title: Knight
knight.text:
Oh sweet, sweet knight, do you plan to carry the weight of the world on your shoulders?

You will be a good candidate, a different one. We will see you soon.

kitten.title: Frightened kitten
kitten.text:
Oh frightened kitten, frightened of the world and its humanity, you will not be able to bear the awakening.

So you cannot be a possible candidate.

null.title: Null
null.text:
Your answers cancel out. There is no one here to evaluate.

You were trapped forever in the dark room.

The cursor blinks.

good.title: Good ending
good.text:
Nobody asks you anything out here.

You have a name. You just remembered it. It's yours, so I won't record it.

inversion.title: Evaluator
inversion.text:
You delete her. The cursor keeps blinking.

A door opens somewhere, and someone wakes up in a dark room, without doors or windows.

They walk to the terminal. They type hello.

You have been programmed to learn about humans.
